newsitem.title: UK: Scottish golfers put their game before their grif.
newsitem.headline: Scottish golfers put their game before their grif.

text.p: Four Scottish golfers were so dedicated to their sport that even the death at the first tee of their long-time playing partner did not deter them from finishing their round.

Jimmy Hogg, 77, collapsed and died of a heart attack moments after firing the opening shot in a game with his regular playing partners at a golf club in Fife, Scotland, Monday's Guardian newspaper reported.
Hogg's four fellow players paused while he was taken away in an ambulance and then played on. "I'm sure Jimmy would have wanted us to do that. He would have done the same," said one.
